name: team-hub
description: A shared panel of team conventions, recommended mods, budgets and rules, synced through the repo.

injectConventions.title: Add the conventions to the system prompt
injectConventions.description: Claude follows the team's conventions from .claude/team.json (a short, stable section, capped at 1,500 characters).

notifyDrift.title: Tell me when my settings differ
notifyDrift.description: One notice per session when your budget, notification or guard settings are weaker than the team's, or recommended mods are missing.
